reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it urges viewers to buy a product package and build a team to earn from recruits’ sales, including bonuses tied to team placement and multiple generations. It reinforces that recruitment pitch with claims that joining early raises the token’s value and that token splits can multiply participants’ money. The presentation is soliciting participation, not teaching a trading method or reporting on someone else’s offer.

citations.quote: to purchase any of our five product packages

The Network Bonus is accumulated on the you get a direct sales bonus. The network bonus is accumulated on the weaker side of your sales team. You receive 10% of all business volume from your sales team.
join today and start building your team
you can split up to two times that means four times your money

opening.argument: The presentation uses qualified, forward-looking language rather than an unconditional promise. It says OneCoin “has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency” and “can be the next Bitcoin,” which presents an expectation, not a guaranteed result. The income discussion is also framed conditionally: viewers are told that “if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses” they must purchase a package. That wording leaves room for market uncertainty and distinguishes participation from guaranteed success. A careful reading therefore supports treating this as optimistic investment commentary with conditional opportunities, rather than a categorical assurance that every viewer will make money.

citations.quote: has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency on the market
this can be the next Bitcoin
if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats promotional wording as proof of deception, but its quoted material does not establish that earnings were guaranteed. “To purchase” identifies a condition of access, while the network passage describes how a bonus is calculated, not an assured outcome. Likewise, “join today” is ordinary promotional urgency, and “four times your money” is a description of the stated split concept. The presentation’s repeated use of potential and conditional language is omitted from that characterization.

citations.quote: has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency on the market
if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses
you can split up to two times that means four times your money

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Qualified words such as “potential” do not make the pitch neutral when the same presentation invites immediate participation and describes money-multiplying outcomes. The statement “if you would like to profit” still directs viewers toward paid packages, and the split language expressly equates two splits with “four times your money.” Those are persuasive financial claims, not merely a warning about uncertainty.

citations.quote: if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have
join today and start building your team
you can split up to two times that means four times your money

opening.argument: The video's central service can reasonably be understood as financial education and operational instruction. It introduces “our One Academy” and says viewers will learn “how to trade and profit from cryptocurrency” through videos, presentations, and quizzes. It also describes a structured five-level program with “a simple step-by-step approach.” The package material is therefore presented as access to a curriculum and platform, with tokens included as a bonus, rather than solely as a recruitment appeal. The content explains trading concepts such as buying low and selling high and describes how the exchange and wallet are intended to function.

citations.quote: Through our One Academy, you will learn how to trade and profit from cryptocurrency
our program is designed in five levels with a simple step-by-step approach guiding you to success
All our packages include excellent educational material from our one Academy learn how to trade for profit buy low sell high

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution calls the presentation a solicitation, but the cited package and team passages do not erase the instructional subject matter. The material explains an academy, educational packages, trading, and an exchange. Mentioning optional bonuses alongside a course does not by itself prove that the video's primary role is a scam rather than a business-training presentation. The cited frames also show organized presentation slides, consistent with a course overview.

citations.quote: Through our One Academy, you will learn how to trade and profit from cryptocurrency
All our packages include excellent educational material from our one Academy learn how to trade for profit buy low sell high

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational label cannot explain the dominant earning pitch. The program is sold with package purchases, and its instruction is expressly tied to profiting, bonuses, tokens, and building a team. The presentation does not merely teach trading principles; it tells viewers to join, buy packages, and earn from sales volume and recruits. Educational packaging therefore functions as part of the solicitation rather than displacing it.

citations.quote: to purchase any of our five product packages
The network bonus is accumulated on the weaker side of your sales team. You receive 10% of all business volume from your sales team
join today and start building your team

opening.argument: The concrete transaction described is an ordinary paid package offering. The presentation lists five package levels, with prices ranging from €100 to €5,000, and says every package includes educational material from the One Academy. It also identifies a free eWallet for payments and tokens included as a bonus. Those details are consistent with selling access to a tiered online service and associated promotional benefits. The supplied material does not state that viewers must surrender credentials, does not describe a guaranteed return on a deposit, and does not establish that a particular viewer will receive income. Referral bonuses can occur in ordinary commerce without proving that the underlying package is fictitious or that every purchase is fraudulent.

citations.quote: Tycoon costs €5000, Executive Trader costs €3000, Pro-Trader costs €1000, Trader costs €500 and our starter is €100
All our packages include excellent educational material from our one Academy
You also receive a free eWallet for safe and secure payments

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution highlights recruitment language but does not show that recruitment is the only or even the entire product. The presentation gives named package tiers, explicit prices, educational contents, and a payment wallet. A referral or sales bonus can be an ordinary promotion attached to a paid service. The quoted split language describes a proposed token feature, but it does not prove that a deposit is guaranteed to return money or that credentials are requested.

citations.quote: Tycoon costs €5000, Executive Trader costs €3000, Pro-Trader costs €1000, Trader costs €500 and our starter is €100
All our packages include excellent educational material from our one Academy
The program gives you special promotions such as cars, luxury watches, and other life changing experiences

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The package format does not make the offer ordinary when compensation is repeatedly tied to recruiting and team volume. The presentation says members receive a percentage of their sales team’s business volume, offers matching bonuses across generations, and urges viewers to build a team. It also promotes token splits as multiplying money. These are central earning mechanisms, not incidental discounts or loyalty benefits, so the absence of a credential request does not resolve the concern.
